title: Success probability of local correction
statement: Let $f:\mathbb F_2^n\to\{-1,1\}$ be within relative Hamming distance at most $\varepsilon$ of the sign-valued parity function associated with a set $S\subseteq\{1,\ldots,n\}$. For every $x\in\mathbb F_2^n$, the fraction of $y\in\mathbb F_2^n$ for which $f(y)f(x+y)$ equals that parity function at $x$ is at least $1-2\varepsilon$.
hypotheses_covered: A Boolean sign-valued function $f$ on $\mathbb F_2^n$
The relative Hamming distance from $f$ to the parity sign associated with $S$ is at most $\varepsilon$
